findings.title: Deleting cache does not invalidate the connected-calendars query
findings.body: The delete-cache mutation only calls the optional `onSuccess` callback. Unlike the disconnect mutation below it, it never invalidates `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`, which is the query supplying `cacheUpdatedAt`. When this component is used without a callback that explicitly refetches that query, a successful deletion leaves the UI showing the old cache timestamp and the delete action until a manual reload. Invalidate the connected-calendars query on mutation settlement/success (and optionally integrations if needed).

findings.title: Cache timestamp is formatted with a hard-coded US locale
findings.body: The component uses `Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US")` even though its surrounding labels are localized through `useLocale`. Users with non-US locales will always receive US date ordering and formatting for the cache status, which conflicts with the localized UI. Format using the active application/user locale instead of a literal `en-US`.

findings.title: Webhook helper cannot update env files on GNU/Linux sed
findings.body: `sed -i '' -E ...` is BSD/macOS syntax. On GNU sed, commonly used on Linux development environments and CI, the separate empty argument is not handled as the intended backup suffix and the command fails rather than updating `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL`. Use a portable conditional for BSD versus GNU sed, or rewrite the file without relying on platform-specific `sed -i` behavior.
